**wQueueSmart** 

Assignment 2: UI / UX Design and Front-End Implementation

1. **GitHub Repository [Link](https://github.com/Yukin3/QueueSmart) :** [https://github.com/Yukin3/QueueSmart](https://github.com/Yukin3/QueueSmart)

2. **Design and Development Methodology** 

**Has methodology changed since Assignment 1**  
Our methodology since assignment 1 has remained the same, with minor tweaks to our approach. These tweaks mainly stemmed from what would be required for the assignment submission this time around. We wanted to make sure we included everything listed in the assignment description while still maintaining our original vision for the UI.

**Why (or why not)**  
Our design was pretty straightforward and agreed upon, so thus far we haven’t run into any issues where something would need to be changed. When we start coding the backend there might be some logical issues we need to sort out, but for now the mock up is serving its intended purpose.

**How work was divided for UI/UX and implementation**  
Work was divided based on which team member felt the strongest and completing which portion of the deliverables. Each team member focused on their specific part to ensure consistency and prevent overlapping work. 

3. **Front-End Technologies and Responsibilities** 

**Front-end technologies used and why**

* React.js for building a front end with reusable components and a smooth user experience.  
* CSS \+ frameworks (tailwind/shadcn/etc) for creating clean and consistent styling for the app’s UI.  
* NPM for installing and reusing project dependencies

**Who worked on what**

* Ainhien:  
  * Client side validation   
* Grace:  
  * User screens, queue status, join/leave functions  
* Martin:   
  * Admin screens, dashboard+analytics, service management, queue management  
* Mmokut:  
  * Auth screens. login/signup pages, user role handling
